samples.question: The three colored tiles in START are ordered left to right. Each COMMAND card has a color chip and a + or − sign. For each card, compare its color with the current middle tile. If they match, rotate the whole three-tile row one place in the sign direction (+ = right, − = left). If they do not match, swap the adjacent pair on that side (+ swaps middle/right; − swaps left/middle). Carry the new order to the next card. Which three-letter code is active after card 7? Answer the code shown in the key.
